name: HirePulse Super-Tool #1 – The $0.035 Clay Killer (Zero-Waste Outbound Sniper)

parameters.content:
## 🎯 Super-Tool #1: The $0.035 Clay Killer (Zero-Waste Outbound Sniper)
Replaces $300–$800/mo Clay & Apollo credit burn by filtering out inactive companies **before** paying for contact enrichment:
1. **Step 1 (Free / $0.01)**: `POST /v1/ats-jobs` + `POST /v1/google-ads` — Checks live hiring velocity (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable) and active Google Ads campaigns.
2. **Step 2 (Pre-Enrichment Gate)**: Drops 80%+ of dead/frozen domains at $0 enrichment cost.
3. **Step 3 ($0.005 + $0.01)**: Runs `POST /v1/tech-stack` + `POST /v1/extract-contacts` ONLY on verified active buyers (Total: **$0.035 per qualified lead**, $0 on empty results).

### 1. Target Domain Batch
Paste up to 50 domains in Settings.
Free sandbox domains: `linear.app`, `stripe.com`, `shopify.com`, `example.com`.

### 2. Zero-Waste Intent Gate
Checks live ATS job postings (`/v1/ats-jobs`) and Google Ads (`/v1/google-ads`). Empty results cost $0.00.

### 3. Qualified Tech + Contact Sniper
Enriches ONLY active buyers with `/v1/tech-stack` + `/v1/extract-contacts` (MX/SPF/DMARC + emails + socials).
